raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: Misread the Wikipedia infobox and incorrectly took 1875 (the birth year of novelist John Buchan, whose work the film is based on) as the director’s birth year. The director of the 1978 film, Don Sharp, was actually born in 1921. This misattribution of a birth year led to an incorrect basis for the comparison and should have been caught by cross-verifying the director’s bio.
